defs.def: an effect that causes things to move in a particular way 力

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨醒来时我都感到一种沉闷的灰色情绪，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

defs.def: a unit for measuring the strength of the wind 风力；风力等级
in large numbers 人

ex.s: Companies could be forced to consumers what information they hold and how many money they make form it.
ex.t: 公司可能被迫向______消费者披露它们持有何种信息以及从中获利多少。

defs.def: being used 法律、规则等
to make sb do sth that they do not want to do 强迫，迫使（某人做某事）
to use physical strength to move sb/sth into a particular position 用力，强行（把 … 移动）
to make sth happen, especially before other people are ready 使发生（尤指趁他人尚未准备）
to make yourself smile, laugh, etc. rather than doing it naturally 强作笑颜；强装欢笑

ex.s: I forced a smile, unsure how to respond further.
ex.t: 我觉得很难，但仍希望能通过。

defs.def: to make fruit, plants, etc. grow or develop faster than normal by keeping them in special conditions 人工催长；加速（水果、植物等）生长；催熟
to run very fast in a race in order to make the other people taking part run faster 迫使（赛跑对手）加速
to make sb do sth faster than they want to 迫使（某人）加快速度
to make yourself eat or drink sth that you do not really want 强迫咽下（食物或饮料）
